limitations: MuJoCo simulation only; no physical NAO calibration. Own simulated sensors are ideal and the physical clock pauses during RGB inference. The keeper uses camera-derived ball measurements; the striker has privileged scene observations with PerceptionNoise v1. v1/v2 opponents are our trained strikers, not an autonomous B-Human team. Motion parameters are shared across mirrored defenses. Balanced normally selects four of six guards; all six are checked for execution/recovery, not independently trained or statistically ranked. Parameter search is a pilot, not full-joint PPO.
